description: The purpose of this course is to familiarize students with the practical implementation of single-stage and multistage amplifiers, oscillators and op-amp-based linear and non-linear circuits. The course develops understanding of amplifier frequency response and the design and analysis of common analog electronic circuits.
experiments: Study the input and output characteristics of transistor CB and CE configurations.
Design a single-stage RC-coupled amplifier and plot its gain-frequency response.
Design a double-stage RC-coupled amplifier and plot its gain-frequency response.
Design an RC phase-shift oscillator using IC 741.
Design a Wien bridge oscillator using IC 741.
Design a voltage-to-current converter and current-to-voltage converter using IC 741.
Study various wave-shaping circuits, including clipper and clamper circuits, using IC 741.
Design and test the performance of integrator and differentiator circuits using Op-Amp IC 741.
Design first-order active low-pass and high-pass filters using Op-Amp IC 741 for a given cutoff frequency.
Design a 4-bit R-2R ladder DAC using an Op-Amp.
outcomes: Design and analyze single-stage and double-stage RC-coupled amplifiers and plot their gain-frequency response.
Design and analyze oscillators using IC 741.
Design and analyze various wave-shaping circuits, including clipper and clamper circuits, using IC 741.
Design and test the performance of integrator and differentiator circuits using Op-Amp IC 741.
Design first-order active low-pass and high-pass filters using Op-Amp IC 741 for a given cutoff frequency.
